tasks.title: The test gate has room for this phase: at least 70 s of GUT time freed without weakening any test
tasks.description: Every other task of this epic depends on this one. Measured at 7916662: import 4.7 s, boot 1.0 s, GUT 253.3 s (1593 tests, 126 scripts), against a harness cap of about 300 s wall clock with up to ~38 s of overhead seen in Phase 4. This epic's new tests are budgeted at 56.5 s (plan section 4.3), so GUT must reach <= 183 s first. Add scripts/gate-time.sh (runs the three gate steps exactly as /agent/verify.sh does, prints each step's wall time, GUT's own Time, the test count and the 15 slowest files from -gjunit_xml_file). Cut GUT time using only the means plan section 2.2 allows, in its order: the 8x clock (time_scale, physics_ticks_per_second and max_physics_steps_per_frame scaled together, restored in after_each) for files that await real physics at 1x (test_level1_fighter_exit.gd, test_ram_corvette.gd, test_level1_drone_exit.gd); test_level1_fighter_fire_density.gd from 4x to 8x; in test_fighter_squad.gd (~65 s) compute each scenario several tests replay identically once (before_all or a memoised helper keyed by its inputs); drop per-tick bookkeeping no assertion reads. Never lower a tick count, duration, sample count or start grid an assertion depends on, never widen a bound; where a scaled clock shifts a measured value, show before/after and that it stays inside its asserted bound. Record the before/after table, the 240 s ceiling, the epic allotments and the 8x / compute-once rules in tests/README.md under a new 'Gate time' heading. If 70 s cannot be freed this way, stop with Result: ESCALATE and the measurements (owner question 4: raise the cap or trim this epic's real-physics rows).
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: scripts/gate-time.sh shows GUT <= 183 s on the dev container and at least 70 s below the 'before' run on the same machine, and prints import, boot and GUT times plus the 15 slowest files; test count unchanged (1593) and every test green; no assertion removed or bound widened (each shifted measured value listed with before/after); scripts/check-test-leaks.sh prints LEAK CHECK PASS; tests/README.md has the Gate time section with the before/after table; gate green.

tasks.title: Enemies can carry a directional shield that eats shots from one side, breaks, reboots and regenerates
tasks.description: Add the HurtBox absorb hook (set_absorber / clear_absorber / has_absorber, signal hit_absorbed(hit_box: HitBox), one slot) to global/components/hurtbox_component.gd, byte-identical without an absorber, and the new EnemyShield component (global/components/enemy_shield.gd, Node2D): arc_deg (>= 360 = bubble, changeable while attached), capacity, regen delay and refill, break absorbed whole then reboot, capped facing turn toward a threat point, sustain mode with heartbeat and fade, cyan drawing in world angles. It never absorbs while its host answers the hit-blind is_armored() == true, and never calls deflects_hit (that damages a plate). Proven on fixtures only (no shipped enemy carries one yet): directional, bubble and local-module (shield on a part's own hurtbox). Records the Phase 1 P-15 decision: DamageReaction is not adopted by BaseEnemy. Stay within the 3.0 s GUT allotment (plan section 4.3); report scripts/gate-time.sh before and after.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Unit rows in tests/unit/test_hitbox_hurtbox.gd and tests/unit/test_enemy_shield.gd and the real-projectile rows (8x clock, <= 6 awaited cases) in tests/integration/test_enemy_shield_hits.gd from plan section 2.3 pass, including the 54/56 degree arc edge, arc 110 -> 360 while attached, the 40-capacity two-hit break boundary, the armoured-host row (absorbs_hit false with points unchanged, true once unarmoured) and the counting fake proving deflects_hit is never asked; a real player bullet from the front is consumed with hull HP unchanged and from behind damages the hull; a beam bypasses the shield; every existing hurtbox test unchanged; GUT delta within 3.0 s and GUT <= 240 s; gate green.
